mapper.select: SELECT uuid as uuId, user_id as userId, user_name as userName, construction_id as constructionId, file_name as fileName, file_size as fileSize, file_path as filePath, create_time as createTime FROM files WHERE construction_id = #{constructionId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM files WHERE uuid = CAST(#{uuId} AS UUID)
